quests.title: Mimetic Replication

dialogue.t: Ah, hello there, Traveler. It would seem that you're here to take part in the Wisdom Gala.
If it would interest you, would you like to try out the game that we at Amurta have set up?

dialogue.sit: And what sort of game would that be?

dialogue.t: Our Darshan has set up a little game called "Mimetic Replication."
In this game, I will introduce you to the behavioral patterns of certain animals.
Of course, these patterns have been simplified and generalized to make them easier to understand.
What you'll need to do is to use the models we have prepared to imitate the actions of the corresponding animals.
Precisely. "Animals have regular behavioral patterns" is a statement that is both simple to understand and accept.
But behind something so simple lie mysteries that are most deep indeed.
However, let us put academic observation aside for the moment and simply enjoy the habitual behaviors of animals in a relaxed manner.

dialogue.sit: I'll give this one a go, why not?
I've got other things to do at the moment.

dialogue.t: Alright. In that case, please step over here.

quests.description: Paz from Amurta seems to be busy with something…
